in_sanskrit.name: देवकर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who carries or transports gods, a divine charioteer.

in_hindi.name: देवकार
in_hindi.long_meaning: देवों के लिए वाहक, दैविक रथ कारक

in_marathi.name: Deevakar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deevakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Deevakar is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘deeva’ meaning god and ‘kar’ meaning message or action. It refers to one who carries the message of the gods or serves as a messenger between the divine world and the human world.
